phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Superconducting magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanner system typically comprising a large-bore superconducting magnet assembly, gradient coil assembly, and radiofrequency (RF) system integrated with cryogenic cooling and digital imaging electronics.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The superconducting MRI scanner is the industry-standard technology for diagnostic imaging, with approximately 90%+ of installed MRI systems worldwide using superconducting magnets due to their superior magnetic field strength (1.5T to 3T) and image quality.
